executive_summary.conclusion: The inspected source pages make the course offer, audience, tuition, eligibility, deadline and application handoff directly readable, and all checked AI and search crawler roles are allowed by robots.txt. Two source journeys reached their intended public destinations; rendered behavior, independent corroboration and actual assistant citations were not measured.

not_checked: Rendered extraction and interactive engagement were not checked because browser tools are prohibited.
Keyboard reachability, visible focus, mobile layout, overlays and rendered context retention were not checked.
Off-site retrieval and independent corroboration were not checked because public search is unavailable in this audit path.
Actual AI assistant citation behavior, provider access logs, Search Console settings and behavioral analytics were not measured.

readiness.detail: robots.txt returned 200 with User-agent: * Allow: /; all listed search, user-fetch and training roles were allowed by the policy parser.

Eight public HTML pages were inspected over HTTP. The saved source exposed readable text, links and successful responses for the five collected pages plus the enrollment guide, application steps and news page.
Four representative visitor questions were tested against the landing, pricing, materials, enrollment and application passages; each required element is supported by captured source text.
No independent public sources were opened; first-party consistency was checked only within the inspected site pages.
Two source journeys followed literal same-site links to public task destinations and reached the intended enrollment and materials contexts. Interactive rendered behavior was unavailable.

intent_tests.question: What does Mosaic Learning offer, for whom, where, and at what tuition?

evidence.quote: Autumn evening language courses for adult learners at 12 Orchard Lane, Exampletown.
Tuition is 180 credits for the autumn term, including tax and required materials. Cancellation is fully refundable until the enrollment deadline.

intent_tests.reason: The landing page states every required offer, audience, location, price, inclusion and cancellation element in two readable passages.

intent_tests.question: Who is eligible and when do autumn classes start and enrollment close?
required_elements: enrollment closes 18 October 2026 at 17:00 local time

evidence.quote: Autumn courses are open to learners aged 18 or older. Classes start on 2 November 2026.
Enrollment closes on 18 October 2026 at 17:00 local time.

intent_tests.reason: The enrollment guide supplies the age threshold, start date, deadline and local-time qualifier.

intent_tests.question: Which learning materials are included, and what do optional workbooks cost?
required_elements: audio practice included at no additional charge

evidence.quote: each enrolled learner receives a printed course reader and access to audio practice at no additional charge.
beginner workbook 12 credits, advanced workbook 15 credits. Prices include tax. Workbooks are optional

intent_tests.reason: The materials and pricing pages together cover included items, optionality, prices and tax.

intent_tests.question: How does a learner apply, and where and when is reception available?
required_elements: visit public reception with proof of age

evidence.quote: Read the enrollment guide, choose a class, then visit our public reception desk with proof of age.
No online submission is required. Reception at 12 Orchard Lane, Exampletown opens weekdays 09:00–17:00.
All published times use Europe/London local time.

intent_tests.reason: The application page gives the complete handoff, in-person requirement, location, hours and timezone.
